literal_meaning: এক কথায় দু'কথায় (one word in two words)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমরা এককথায় দু'কথায় বিকেল গড়িয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Time passed in one word two words.
We spent the afternoon in casual conversation.
note: Idiom implies time passing unnoticed during informal talk
